text:
nate.pm: Heads-up  We need a compact, customer-facing definition of routing primitives for the long-term roadmap. Aim: unambiguous MVP deliverables + launch criteria. Thoughts?

eli.eng: Key engineering asks: machine-readable policies, clear perf envelopes per path, and an opt-in toggle per tenant. Keep runtime hooks minimal.

mira.arch: Proposal (concise): three primitives \u2014 affinity, fallback, quarantine. Each maps directly to runtime behavior and has a tiny set of knobs: ttl_seconds, strict, priority, fallback_policy. Example human-first doc: 
```yaml
policy_name: standard_affinity
primitive: affinity
preferred_regions: [us-east-1, us-west-2]
strict: false
ttl_seconds: 600
```
This is intentionally opinionated to reduce variants.

sam.sre: Ops must-haves: immutable decision logs, per-policy health metrics, and per-tenant emergency disable. Canary gate: <2% fallback on synthetic traffic for 7d and one controlled failover drill. Clear runbooks and auto-rollback triggers.

hannah.legal: Legal/compliance: decision logs must include tenant_id_hash, reason, timestamp, and region chosen. Need an audit export for regulated customers (90d encrypted). Residency hints must be surfaced for legal review.

kevin.sales: Customers want deterministic fallback order so they can prep endpoints, migration SLAs, and a standard SOW template.

nate.pm: Draft acceptance criteria: 1) Policy spec + 4 examples (single-region, cross-region fallback, strict residency, quarantine) 2) Runtime implements affinity/fallback/quarantine with tenant opt-in 3) Decision logs to blob store: policy_name, tenant_id_hash, input_hash, selected_backend, reason, latency_ms, token_estimate, model_family, policy_revision 4) Telemetry: 50/95/99 latency + token cost per policy path 5) Canary: 7-day synthetic + 1 dry-run failover + rollback automation tested 6) Customer onboarding packet + migration SLA 7) Compliance-ready audit export.

eli.eng: For perf targets: affinity path within +10% of baseline 95th, fallback path allowed +30%. Retention default 30d. Also publish a supported-models matrix for MVP.

mira.arch: I'll add a \"model-risk\" gating table listing families that need validation. Also propose a JSON schema for policy objects to make adoption easy.

sam.sre: Alerting: page when fallback_rate > 3% over 5m. Daily aggregate fallback counts by tenant. We'll schedule a staged cutover rehearsal after canary.

hannah.legal: For EU customers, strict residency=true must enforce no cross-region backup. Document enforcement and audit evidence.

kevin.sales: I'll map top migration accounts and draft SOW language.

nate.pm: Owners & ETAs:
- Mira: policy spec + model gating table (ETA 2w)
- Eli: runtime schema + opt-in plan + perf targets (ETA 3w)
- Sam: telemetry contract + alerting + canary checklist (ETA 2w)
- Hannah: compliance export + residency enforcement doc (ETA 1.5w)
- Kevin: customer migration ask list + sample SOW (ETA 1w)
I'll synthesize into a short RFC for roadmap triage. Any missing pieces?

eli.eng: Risk: kernel/quant changes could alter SLOs. Recommend limiting initial supported model families and making the rest opt-in.

mira.arch: Agreed. We'll include a supported-models section and a simple JSON schema for policies.

sam.sre: I'm scheduling the staging rehearsal after canary passes. Blocking capacity now.

nate.pm: Great. I'll produce the RFC draft and slot for next week's triage. :calendar:
